messages.subject: CFA (RMSEA) and MGCFA (variance-covariance matrix)
parts:
Hi!

Thank you for your previous help.

I removed the free residual covariance as suggested, but the warning message still persists.  

I checked the rank of the Jacobian matrix and confirmed that the number of free parameters also matches the rank.

I also inspected for non-significant parameters and Heywood cases, but none were found.

The determinant of the variance-covariance matrix is  -9.427349e-21

VIF results for both groups suggest no multicollinearity issues (all VIF values are below 3).
I'm not sure what else to look for. Is there anything I might be overlooking?

Thanks for any guidance!

Maria Vale
